what: Capital One Shopping reports Etsy user demographics: 28.9% aged 25–34 (largest cohort), 18.3% aged 35–44, 17.5% aged 18–24; 58.4% female shoppers.
verbatim_snippet: "Most Etsy shoppers (64.7%) are under 44 years old. 28.9% of Etsy users are between the ages of 25 and 34 years. 17.5% of Etsy users are aged 18 to 25, and 18.3% are aged 35 to 44. Female shoppers account for 58.4% of Etsy users."
notes: Secondary source citing SimilarWeb data. Web traffic demographics may differ from purchaser demographics. Fetch status uncertain; degraded to provisional.
